Hi Suzanne — thanks for sending this over and for the clear notes. A couple of items before procurement can issue the PO:

1) Signatory authority: we need a brief stamped/printed attest from your company confirming Martin Cole is authorized to sign tax documents on behalf of Peregrine Systems Ltd. A short email from an officer or a one‑line statement on company letterhead is sufficient.

2) Capacity and chapter 3 withholding: the W-8BEN-E you sent has treaty claim boxes selected. For our finance team to code withholding correctly we need the treaty article reference and whether Peregrine will accept a 0% withholding or expects us to withhold under default rates. Please confirm.

3) Remittance details: good to have accounts@peregrine.co.uk; please include an IBAN and VAT registration number if available so we can populate the vendor master correctly.

I've CC'd Kimberly (Tax/Procurement) and Ben (AP lead) so they can review the form for acceptance and flag any additional evidence. If you can provide the short attest + updated remittance PDF, we can aim to issue a conditional PO (PO will be issued with a note that final payment requires the signed attest).

Thanks — we try to keep this quick.

Laura Bennett
Vendor Onboarding Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com

Forwarding vendor docs — reviewed the W-8BEN-E and the authority letter. Summary and recommended next steps:

- W-8BEN-E: acceptable as submitted; foreign TIN (UK UTR) populated and treaty box properly referenced on page 4. No U.S. EIN present — not required for non-US vendor.
- Authority letter: matches signatory shown on the form and includes officer name + signature + company stamp.
- Remittance details: IBAN and VAT present; banking institution matches company registration.

Recommendation: issue conditional PO number PROC-5812‑RED (conditional payment: final invoice release contingent on standard vendor master KYC checks which are already underway). AP (Ben) to confirm PO amount and payment terms, then Procurement to send PO and onboarding packet.

Ben — if you confirm PO amount and terms I will trigger the PO and mark vendor onboarding as "accepted — conditional."

Thanks,
Kimberly
Tax & Vendor Compliance Lead
